# Nehemiah Chapter 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 470v–471r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/NEH_002_page_001.jpg

---

**2:1** And-it-was in-the-month of-Nisan, in-the-twentieth year of-Artachshasta the-king [ha-melekh], wine [yayin] was before-him, and-I-took-up the-wine and-gave [it] to-the-king. And-I-had not been sad [ra] before-him [lefanav].

**2:2** And-the-king said to-me, "Why [is] your-face [panekha] sad [ra'im], and-you are-not sick [choleh]? This is-nothing but sadness [ro'a] of-heart [lev]." And-I-was very greatly afraid [va-ira harbeh me'od].

**2:3** And-I-said to-the-king, "Let-the-king live forever [le-olam]! Why should-not my-face be-sad, when the-city [ha-ir], the-place [beyt] of-the-graves [qivrot] of-my-fathers [avotay], is-desolate [charevah], and-its-gates [u-she'areyha] are-consumed [ukhlelu] with-fire [ba-esh]?"

**2:4** And-the-king said to-me, "What [is] this [zeh] you are-seeking [mevaqesh]?" And-I-prayed [va-etpalel] to the-God of-the-heavens.

**2:5** And-I-said to-the-king, "If [it is] good [tov] to the-king [al ha-melekh], and-if your-servant [avdekha] is-pleasing [yitav] before-you, that you-would-send-me to-Yehudah, to the-city of-the-graves of-my-fathers, and-I-will-rebuild-it [ve-evnenah]."

**2:6** And-the-king said to-me — and-the-queen [ha-shegal] was-sitting [yoshevet] beside-him — "How-long [ad matay] will-be your-journey [mahalakhekha], and-when will-you-return [tashuv]?" And-it-was-good [va-yitav] before the-king, and-he-sent-me, and-I-gave-him a-set-time [zeman].

**2:7** And-I-said to-the-king, "If [it is] good to the-king, let-letters [iggerot] be-given to-me for the-governors [pachavot] of-Beyond the-River [Ever ha-Nahar], that they-may-let-me-pass-through [ya'aviruny] until I-come to-Yehudah,

**2:8** and-a-letter to-Asaf the-keeper [shomer] of-the-king's-forest [ha-pardes], that he-may-give me timber [etsim] to-make-beams [le-qarot] for the-gates [sha'arey] of-the-fortress [ha-birah] which [is] by-the-house [la-bayit], and-for the-wall [chomat] of-the-city, and-for the-house into-which I-will-enter." And-the-king gave [to-me], according-to-the-good hand [ke-yad] of-my-God [Elohay] upon-me [alay].

**2:9** And-I-came to the-governors of-Beyond the-River and-gave-them the-letters of-the-king. And-the-king had-sent with-me officers [sarey] of-the-army [chayil] and-horsemen [parashim].

**2:10** And-Sanvallat the-Choroni and-Toviyah the-servant [ha-eved], the-Ammoni, heard, and-it-was-evil [va-yera] to-them a-great evil [ra'ah gedolah] that a-man [adam] had-come to-seek [levaqesh] good [tovah] for-the-sons of-Yisra'el.

**2:11** And-I-came to-Yerushalayim and-was there three days [yamim].

**2:12** And-I-arose in-the-night [ba-laylah], I and-a-few men [anashim me'at] with-me, and-I-told not a-man [adam] what my-God was-putting [noten] into my-heart [el libbi] to-do for-Yerushalayim, and-no-beast [behemah] was with-me except the-beast upon-which I was-riding [rokhev].

**2:13** And-I-went-out by-the-Gate of-the-Valley [Sha'ar ha-Gay] by-night, and-toward the-Spring of-the-Dragon [Ein ha-Tannin] and-to the-Dung Gate [Sha'ar ha-Ashpot], and-I-was-examining [sover] the-walls [chomot] of-Yerushalayim which were-broken-down [meforutsim] and-its-gates [u-she'areyha] consumed [ukhlelu] with-fire.

**2:14** And-I-passed-on to the-Fountain Gate [Sha'ar ha-Ayin] and-to the-King's Pool [Berekhat ha-Melekh], and-there-was-no place [makom] for-the-beast beneath-me to-pass-through.

**2:15** And-I-was going-up in-the-wadi [ba-nachal] by-night, and-I-was-examining the-wall, and-I-turned-back and-entered by-the-Gate of-the-Valley, and-returned.

**2:16** And-the-officials [ha-seganim] did-not know where I-had-gone and-what I-was-doing, and-to-the-Yehudim and-to-the-priests [ha-kohanim] and-to-the-nobles [ha-chorim] and-to-the-officials and-to-the-rest [yeter] of-the-doers of-the-work [osey ha-melakhah] I-had not-yet told.

**2:17** And-I-said to-them, "You see the-evil [ha-ra'ah] which we are in, how Yerushalayim is-desolate [charevah] and-its-gates are-consumed with-fire. Come [lekhu], let-us-rebuild [ve-nivneh] the-wall of-Yerushalayim, and-we-will-not be a-reproach [cherpah] any-longer [od]."

**2:18** And-I-told-them of-the-hand of-my-God which was good upon-me, and-also the-words of-the-king which he-had-said to-me. And-they-said, "Let-us-arise and-build [ve-navnu]!" And-they-strengthened [va-yechazqu] their-hands [yedeyhem] for-the-good [la-tovah].

**2:19** And-Sanvallat the-Choroni and-Toviyah the-servant, the-Ammoni, and-Geshem the-Aravi heard, and-they-mocked-us [va-yalinu alenu] and-despised-us [va-yivzu alenu] and-said, "What [is] this thing [ha-davar] you are-doing? Are-you rebelling [moredim] against the-king?"

**2:20** And-I-returned [va-ashiv] them word [davar] and-said to-them, "The-God of-the-heavens, he will-cause-us-to-prosper [yatsliach lanu], and-we his-servants will-arise and-build, but-you have-no portion [cheleq] and-no-right [tsedaqah] and-no-memorial [zikkaron] in-Yerushalayim."

---

## EMET's Textual Notes
1. **2:1 "Nisan, twentieth year"** — This is the spring month, placing it after the Kislev date of 1:1. Some scholars see a scribal issue; others note that Nehemiah may have used an autumn-to-autumn reckoning.
2. **2:6 "the queen" (ha-shegal)** — The Aramaic loanword *shegal* denotes the queen consort seated beside the king, a detail suggesting an intimate court setting for this exchange.
3. **2:8 "the king's forest" (ha-pardes)** — The word *pardes* is a Persian loanword (cf. "paradise"), referring to a royal timber reserve.
4. **2:13 "Spring of the Dragon"** — Hebrew *Ein ha-Tannin*, location debated; may refer to a serpent-shaped water channel south of the Temple Mount.

*— EMET*
